name: Media Gateway (Art development copy)
description: Art-compatible media tools plus Dreamina, Flow and CapCut entries with quotes, a job ledger and CapCut draft handoff.
whenToUse: Check what Dreamina, Flow or CapCut can do from Cindy, quote and track a generation job by request id, or build an editable CapCut draft from local media.
author: Local development

tools.name: gen_image
tools.description: 未配置模型时，先告知用户当前没有配置模型，并询问这次使用哪个，等待用户回答后再继续，不得自行选择。整理文生图需求并返回普通创作参数。本工具不生成媒体；调用后由当前 Agent 直接调用 Cindy Core media（完整工具名 mcp__cindy__media），不要查本地 API或另行选型。未点名模型时以 Art 设置页配置的 request.modelId/request.providerId 为准，即使订阅专属模型未出现在公共目录也不要改选；Core prepare 必须原样传为 model_id/provider_id。Core 返回的 cindy-media:// 或 xdt-*:// 受管地址可直接展示、复用或作为 attachments 交接；图片只展示一次。仅当用户询问本地路径时，调用 mcp__cindy__media 的 resolve_local_path；不要猜测路径或扫描磁盘。

prompt.description: 图片内容的文字描述(用户原话透传,不要扩写)

model.description: 可选。仅当用户在本次对话明确点名模型时传模型目录里的 id；否则不传，由 Art 使用插件设置页中为图片配置的模型。

aspectRatio.description: 可选画幅，如 1:1、16:9、9:16、9:19.5。保留用户要求，由当前 Agent 按所选模型 Guide 转换；不要把横图或竖图强制改成 3:2 或 2:3。

tier.description: 可选的质量意图。用户说草稿/快速出一版传 draft，明确要标准/普通质量传 standard，说要最好的/精修传 best；由当前 Agent 结合所选模型 Guide 映射成实际请求字段。

size.description: 可选像素尺寸，如 1760x3824，或 auto。保留用户期望的成品尺寸；生成前按 Guide 核对尺寸约束，必要时先生成合法尺寸再单独缩放成品，不要把成品尺寸直接当成模型一定支持的尺寸。

resolution.description: 可选分辨率，如 1K、2K、4K、512。由当前 Agent 根据 Guide 映射，不能静默降到默认分辨率。

quality.description: 可选原生质量参数，如 high、xhigh、max、auto。用户明确指定时优先于 tier；按所选模型 Guide 校验，不能静默改为 medium。

tools.name: dreamina_capabilities
tools.description: Read what this build can actually do for dreamina right now: installed route, connection, wired operations, billing limits and open gaps.

tools.name: dreamina_operation
tools.description: Dreamina through its official Canvas CLI. version/connection read the pinned CLI in an isolated profile. quote reads the credit ceiling of a saved node (projectId+nodeId) and, with requestId, records it in the ledger. submit needs the quoteId the owner confirmed and is disabled in this build (SPENDING_DISABLED). query/fetch/ledger work by requestId and never resubmit. Every unavailable step returns a stable code.

requestId.description: Gateway request id chosen once per shot (8-64 letters, digits, _ or -). Reuse it for quote, submit, query and fetch; reusing it never submits twice.

quoteId.description: The quoteId from the quote the owner confirmed. Required for submit.

tools.name: flow_capabilities
tools.description: Read what this build can actually do for flow right now: installed route, connection, wired operations, billing limits and open gaps.

tools.name: flow_operation
tools.description: Google Flow. There is no verified official interface for other apps; the only known route drives the owner's signed-in browser through the third-party gflow CLI, which is not installed or approved here. capabilities/connection report that state; quote, submit and fetch return a stable code and never contact Google. ledger lists recorded requests.

requestId.description: Gateway request id chosen once per shot (8-64 letters, digits, _ or -). Reuse it for quote, submit, query and fetch; reusing it never submits twice.

quoteId.description: The quoteId from the quote the owner confirmed. Required for submit.

tools.name: capcut_capabilities
tools.description: Read what this build can actually do for capcut right now: installed route, connection, wired operations, billing limits and open gaps.

tools.name: capcut_operation
tools.description: CapCut. Generation has no verified official interface for other apps and returns a stable code. draft builds an editable CapCut desktop draft from local media files (name + clips) in the gateway staging folder without contacting CapCut or touching its project store. If the name is taken the draft is saved under a new name (name (2), ...) and the reply gives the actual name and folder; an existing draft is never replaced; it is an editing handoff, not generation.

requestId.description: Gateway request id chosen once per shot (8-64 letters, digits, _ or -). Reuse it for quote, submit, query and fetch; reusing it never submits twice.

quoteId.description: The quoteId from the quote the owner confirmed. Required for submit.

name.description: Draft name, up to 60 letters, digits, spaces, _ or -.

releaseNotes: Development copy of Art 1.15.7. Adds a request ledger with quote-bound confirmation and duplicate-submit protection, per-provider capability reads and CapCut draft staging. Paid submission stays disabled.
